Direction (Jack Heart, 2026-11-12): "Should also be able to use fixed reference policies?" Yes: a Seating seat is one of three kinds, and all three must work and be documented together: the held checkpoint (`Inference`), a fixed player (`Code`, such as a heuristic, or a `Model` of one chosen checkpoint, such as an initialization or a frozen anchor), or a relative seat (`Earlier`, `Fraction`, `At`, `Aligned`). Fixed seats exist on Matchup today; keep them, and draw a seating against a fixed player with the same Curve.
